text: The target transfers its supplied input stream into an about:blank channel with a null principal, passes that channel as async converter context, opens the conversion listener, then waits on a consuming listener. The local comment explains that recording request stop synchronizes the fuzz loop. It does not assert decoded output correctness, a bounded timeout or all MIME/security cases. The original init is empty; later current preference clearing is separate. No fuzz run or build occurred, and the restricted review plus uncollected primary discussion keep the entry incomplete.
title: The MIME fuzz entry waits for async conversion completion before its next iteration
